Package org.cyborgcats.ssm

Class Step

java.lang.Object
org.cyborgcats.ssm.Step
public final class Step extends Object
A single executable unit within a State, running its body on a dedicated daemon thread. The body cooperatively yields control back to the scheduler each robot loop by calling pause(), waitSeconds(double), or await(BooleanSupplier).

Steps are not subclassable and are created for you by State.withStep(CheckedRunnable); the public surface here is the set of static helpers a body calls to suspend itself.

  • Method Details

    • pause

      public static void pause() throws InterruptedException
      Suspends execution of the current step body for one scheduler loop iteration. Must only be called from within a step body.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the step's thread is interrupted (e.g., because the step was ended externally)
      IllegalStateException - if called from a thread that is not running a step body

    • loop

      public static void loop(Step.CheckedRunnable body) throws InterruptedException
      Executes the provided body in an infinite loop, yielding to the scheduler between each iteration. This method never returns normally; the step ends only when interrupted.
      Parameters:
      body - the code to execute each iteration
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the step's thread is interrupted

    • waitSeconds

      public static void waitSeconds(double seconds) throws InterruptedException
      Suspends the current step body until the specified duration has elapsed.

      Named waitSeconds rather than wait so it cannot be confused with Object.wait(long), which would block the calling thread without yielding to the scheduler.

      Parameters:
      seconds - the minimum time to wait in seconds
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the step's thread is interrupted

    • await

      public static void await(BooleanSupplier condition) throws InterruptedException
      Suspends the current step body, yielding each loop until the condition returns true.
      Parameters:
      condition - the condition to poll each loop iteration
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the step's thread is interrupted
